The /agents/deployments/read API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

AgentDeploymentResponse Model - Response wrapping a single agent deployment.
success boolean
Indicate if the API request was successful.
errors string Array
List of errors with the API call.
deployment AgentDeployment object
An agent deployment instance of a task.
Example 
{
  "success": true,
  "errors": [
    "string"
  ],
  "deployment": {
    "deploymentId": "A-a5d782221843ac9aa99211e3b1949c01",
    "agentId": 47,
    "status": "InQueue",
    "taskId": 0,
    "model": "string",
    "created": "string",
    "started": "string",
    "ended": "string",
    "machine": "string",
    "mcpTools": [
      "string"
    ],
    "hostName": "string",
    "prompt": "string",
    "projectId": 0,
    "versionId": 0,
    "runtimeError": "string"
  }
}
AgentDeployment Model - An agent deployment instance of a task.
deploymentId string
example: A-a5d782221843ac9aa99211e3b1949c01
Identifier of the deployment.
agentId integer
example: 47
Identifier of the agent the deployment runs.
status string Enum
Current status of the deployment. Options : ['InQueue', 'Running', 'Completed', 'Stopped', 'Failed']
taskId integer
Identifier of the parent task.
model string
Model identifier used by the deployment, when set.
created string
Creation timestamp.
started string
nullable
Start timestamp, or null if not yet started.
ended string
nullable
End timestamp, or null if still active.
machine string
nullable
Machine the deployment is running on.
mcpTools string Array
MCP tools available to the deployment.
hostName string
nullable
Hostname of the deployment, when running.
prompt string
Prompt the deployment is executing.
projectId integer
Identifier of the project the deployment runs against.
versionId integer
Identifier of the LEAN version the deployment runs.
runtimeError string
nullable
Runtime error reported by the deployment, when one occurred.
Example 
{
  "deploymentId": "A-a5d782221843ac9aa99211e3b1949c01",
  "agentId": 47,
  "status": "InQueue",
  "taskId": 0,
  "model": "string",
  "created": "string",
  "started": "string",
  "ended": "string",
  "machine": "string",
  "mcpTools": [
    "string"
  ],
  "hostName": "string",
  "prompt": "string",
  "projectId": 0,
  "versionId": 0,
  "runtimeError": "string"
}

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
Header
